svg.title: Laundry worker — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as laundry worker, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: Two folded linen pieces sit above a tapered laundry basket with three open slats. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, an oval face.
